sections.heading: Bring operations and customer engagement together
sections.body:
When growing teams rely on disconnected sales, service and operational tools, agree the journeys that need to connect first. Zoho is part of our enterprise platform portfolio; Linkfields shapes application selection, configuration, integration and adoption around your priorities.

Define the applications, users and interfaces in scope, with clear responsibilities for Zoho configuration and integration with your existing systems.
sections.secondaryHeading: Choose the applications; keep clear boundaries
sections.secondaryBody: Map sales visibility, service handling and operational hand-offs to the required applications. Confirm editions, users, market-specific accounting and localisation, then decide what stays in your existing ERP. [Explore Intelligent Enterprise Platforms](/services/intelligent-enterprise-platforms).

sections.heading: Build ownership into data and daily work
sections.body:
Agree who owns customer and operational records, roles, approval rules and migration exceptions. Validate access and complete journeys with business users before launch, then transfer training, monitoring and service responsibilities.

[Cyber Security](/services/cyber-security), [Quality engineering](/services/digital-transformation/quality-engineering) and [delivery accelerators](/products-and-accelerators/delivery-accelerators) support the agreed controls. Analytics or AI work has its own data, approval and governance scope.

sections.heading: Questions before you begin
sections.description: Bring the current tools, required users and the customer or operational hand-offs you want to improve.

items.title: Which Zoho applications are included?
items.description: The engagement names the applications, editions, users and processes after fit-gap discovery. Sales, service and operational hand-offs are buyer needs to map, not confirmation that every Zoho application or local accounting requirement is covered.

items.title: Can our existing ERP stay in place?
items.description: Yes, it can remain the system of record within an agreed integration design. Define which records Zoho owns, which stay in ERP, how changes synchronise and who handles exceptions; platform and interface feasibility are assessed first.

items.title: When should we extend rather than configure?
items.description: Use configuration when it meets the process need. An extension requires a business gap, owner, interface and test scope. Linkworks is a composable option where an application or portal sits outside the selected ERP/CRM scope.

items.title: How are delivery and support bought?
items.description: Time & Materials fits selection and evolving scope; Fixed Price fits defined milestones and acceptance. Managed Service or a Dedicated Team can provide ongoing support with agreed responsibilities and service levels. Outcome-Based terms need evidenced measures; software is available separately. [Explore engagement models](/company/our-approach#engagement-models).
